Smørbukkveien: 65% fast stilling med arbeidstid for tiden aktiv natt
Mikkelsbærstien: 2 X 64% fast stilling med arbeidstid for tiden passiv natt.                                                                                                                                                                                   
Ved mangel på kvalifiserte søkere til fast ansettelse, kan andre søkere bli vurdert for ansettelse i midlertidige stillinger/vikariater.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bistå beboerne og sikre at de får nødvendig hjelp og kvalitativt gode tjenester
  • Dokumentere i elektronisk journal (Profil)

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Det er ønskelig at du har kjennskap til og erfaring fra arbeid med utfordrende atferd
  • Du må kunne bruke digitale systemer da stillingen krever dokumentasjon i elektronisk journal
  • Krav om norskferdigheter på minimum nivå B1
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest er en forutsetning for ansettelse. Denne skal ikke legges ved søknaden, men må leveres snarest etter tilbud om ansettelse og før tiltredelse

Legg ved attester og vitnemål i søknaden (lastes inn som vedlegg i Webcruiter).

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Sandnes kommune ser vi framover med glød og optimisme. Vi er i sterk vekst. Vi er unge. Vi søker nye løsninger og legger til rette for en bærekraftig utvikling. Vi har også spennende langsiktige planer for byutvikling og er det geografiske midtpunktet i en dynamisk region. Det er ikke tilfeldig at visjonen vår lyder slik den gjør: Sandnes – i sentrum for framtiden.

Sandnes kommune ligger sentralt på Nord-Jæren, er Norges 11. mest folkerike kommuner og kjennetegnes av mange, varierte kvaliteter. Kommunen består av etablerte storby- og tettstedsområder og er en av fylkes største landbrukskommuner. Vi har idrettsmiljø i norgestoppen, et yrende kulturliv og friluftsområder for hele regionen. Kommunen har et aktivt og innovativt næringsliv og en sterk kulturhistorie. Sandnes er alt dette og mer!

Vi tilbyr våre ansatte utfordrende arbeidsplasser hvor verdiene romslig, modig og sunn står i fokus. Vi søker stadig aktive, engasjerte og selvstendige medarbeidere.

title: Ophthalmologist – Hospital in Eastern Norway
description:
Ophthalmologist – Hospital in Eastern NorwayWe are seeking an Ophthalmologist

A hospital in Eastern Norway is seeking a qualified and motivated Ophthalmologist to join its ophthalmology department.

This is an attractive opportunity for a specialist who wishes to relocate to Norway and work within the public healthcare system. The position involves varied clinical responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and the opportunity to develop your expertise in line with your experience and professional interests.

 

As an Ophthalmologist, your responsibilities may include:

  • Examination, assessment and treatment of patients with ophthalmic conditions.
  • Outpatient consultations and patient follow-up.
  • Performing ophthalmic procedures and surgery according to your qualifications and experience.
  • Preoperative assessments and postoperative follow-up.
  • Collaboration with other medical specialties and healthcare professionals.
  • Participation in multidisciplinary meetings, departmental activities and quality-improvement work.
  • Participation in the on-call rota in accordance with applicable agreements and your level of competence.
  • Supervision and training of colleagues and medical students where relevant.

 

We are looking for a physician who:

  • Is a specialist in ophthalmology, or is approaching completion of specialist training.
  • Holds a medical degree from an EU/EEA country.
  • Has relevant clinical experience in ophthalmology.
  • Is able to work independently while also contributing actively to a multidisciplinary team.
  • Has strong clinical judgement and a patient-centred approach.
  • Has good communication and collaboration skills.
  • Is motivated to learn Norwegian and relocate to Norway.

Before starting work, you must have:

  • Norwegian medical authorisation.
  • Norwegian specialist approval in ophthalmology.
  • Documented Norwegian language skills at a minimum B2 level.

Dignus Medical will assist you throughout the process of applying for Norwegian medical authorisation and Norwegian specialist approval. We also offer free Norwegian language training, enabling you to achieve the required B2 level before you start working.

 

What the hospital offers

  • A professionally stimulating position at a hospital in Eastern Norway.
  • Varied clinical responsibilities adapted to your experience and professional interests.
  • A supportive and multidisciplinary working environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuing education.
  • Free Norwegian language training.

Relocation to Norway

This position is particularly suitable for qualified Ophthalmologists from EU/EEA countries who are considering relocating to Norway.

 

Dignus Medical will support you throughout the process, including:

  • Assessment of your qualifications and documentation.
  • Guidance regarding Norwegian medical authorisation.
  • Guidance regarding Norwegian specialist approval.
  • Free Norwegian language training.
  • Assistance with practical matters related to relocation.
  • Introduction to the workplace and local community.
  • Follow-up before and during your relocation to Norway.

Application

Please submit your CV and a short motivation letter in English or Norwegian. You are also welcome to include relevant documentation regarding your medical education, specialist training, authorisation and work experience.

 

 

Do you want to know more? Feel free to reach out, we would love to hear from you!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film and join us on our journey!

title: Attaché at the Belgian Embassy in Oslo
description:
Offer / conditions:

  • Duration: 1 year contract (permanent contract possible afterwards)

  • A full-time contract (37,5 hours per week) will be offered at a salary (gross monthly salary) of 54.187,98 NOK / month (can be reviewed on the basis of documented and relevant experience)

  • A holiday entitlement of 26 days (already adjusted pro rota to the duration of the contract). In addition, the Embassy offers 14 public holidays throughout the calendar year including the period between Christmas and New Year.

  • Location: The Embassy is housed in a centrally-located building near Aker Brygge in Oslo and is easily accessible by public transport.

  • Closing date for applications: 6 September 2026 at 23:59.

About the Embassy of Belgium in Oslo

The Embassy of Belgium in Oslo is a small, dynamic team of professionals providing diplomatic and consular services in Norway and Iceland. The Embassy is committed to delivering high quality services to its stakeholders in the host countries as well as in Belgium, while actively promoting Belgium's interests and values.

About the Position

The Embassy of Belgium in Oslo is seeking to recruit a proactive and detail‑oriented Attaché working predominantly on political and economic files. The position requires a high degree of integrity, initiative and a hands-on approach. As the Embassy operates with a small team, the successful candidate should be comfortable working in a versatile role, enjoy taking responsibility, and be motivated by the diversity of tasks inherent to a diplomatic post.

Main duties and responsibilities

  • Monitor and report on political, economic and administrative/legal developments within the Embassy's jurisdiction, with particular attention to EU‑related matters, energy and security policy.

  • Collect, analyse and interpret information related to current Norwegian, and if necessary, Icelandic affairs; monitor local media and relevant social networks.

  • Draft analytical reports and summaries in French or Dutch.

  • Participate in and help organise official activities of the diplomatic post, including meetings, conferences, seminars, and receptions.

  • Develop and maintain a professional network on behalf of the Embassy by attending events, conferences and symposia organised by third parties.

  • Contribute to the promotion of strong bilateral relations and cooperation with the receiving States and relevant international organisations; assess and report on the perception of Belgium within these circles.

  • Develop and support the Embassy's social media activities to promote its priorities and amplify its public profile.

  • Maintain and update internal reference tools, including country or thematic reports, instructions, information on local legislation, contact lists and other relevant databases.

  • Provide back‑up support in consular matters, if required.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Education: A Master's degree or equivalent (five‑year university degree) in international relations, law, economics, political science, or a closely related field.

  • Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, and at least one of the following languages: French or Dutch, which are used for internal reporting. Knowledge of Norwegian is considered a strong asset.

  • Professional experience: At least 1 year of work experience in a governmental organisation, an international organisation, an NGO, a university or research institution, a media organisation, a think tank, a foundation, a diplomatic mission, a development agency, a civil society organisation, a policy or advocacy organisation, or a similar organisation with activities in public affairs, communications, research, international cooperation, or diplomacy.

  • Core competencies:

    • Ability to work under time pressure and meet strict deadlines;

    • Strong analytical, drafting and reporting skills;

    • Excellent interpersonal and networking skills, with the capacity to represent Belgium professionally;

    • Advanced knowledge of European or international affairs.

    • A good knowledge of Norwegian politics or economics is a strong asset.

    • Expertise in energy and/or climate policy is considered a strong asset.

    • Sound political judgement and discretion.

Application process

Conditions of Employment:

  • Legal status: Applicants must be eligible to live and work in Norway at the time of application.

  • Before an offer of employment can be made, candidates must provide proof a local Norwegian address so that if selected, it will appear on the contract offered.

  • Proof of educational qualifications and prior experience will be required at or after the interview stage of the process.

Application/recruitment process: please submit your application by email to oslo.jobs@diplobel.fed.be. Your application should include a concise motivation letter and CV (two separate PDF documents) in either Dutch or French and should be submitted by 23:59 on 6 September 2026 at the latest.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Embassy of Belgium in Oslo is a small, dynamic team of professionals providing diplomatic and consular services in Norway and Iceland. The Embassy is committed to delivering high quality services to its stakeholders in the host countries as well as in Belgium, while actively promoting Belgium's interests and values.

title: Front-Desk Rental Agent for Camper Vans
description:
Arctic Campers AS is looking for a Rental Agent to join our team in Tromsø. We are looking for a service-minded, reliable, and positive team player who enjoys working with customers in an international environment.

As a Rental Agent, you will be responsible for welcoming customers, managing vehicle pickups and returns, and ensuring a professional handover of our camper vans and rental vehicles. You will also support the daily operation by coordinating bookings, assisting customers, and helping keep the station running efficiently.

Educational and Skill Requirements

  • Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, tourism, or a similar role is an advantage

  • Good command of English (additional languages such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian are an advantage)

  • Valid Category B driver's license

  • Strong communication and organizational skills

  • Independent and structured working style

  • Positive attitude, honesty, and ability to work well in a team

Main Responsibilities

  • Welcoming customers and managing vehicle pickups and returns

  • Explaining rental agreements and camper van functions

  • Completing rental documentation and processing payments and deposits

  • Answering phone calls, emails, and customer inquiries

  • Coordinating vehicle pickups, returns, and daily bookings

  • Organizing airport pickups when required

  • Keeping the reception and front office clean, tidy, and organized

  • Supporting operational tasks such as vehicle preparation, quality inspections, and reporting technical issues

  • Other related tasks as required

Working Hours

You will work 5 days per week , with 7.5 working hours per day and a 30-minute unpaid lunch break.

Working Permit

Arctic Campers AS welcomes applications from both Norwegian residents and international candidates.

  • Norwegian citizens: No work permit is required.

  • EU/EEA citizens: We will assist with the necessary paperwork required to register and work legally in Norway.

  • Non-EU/EEA citizens: We do not sponsor work visas or residence permits. Applicants who require visa sponsorship are unfortunately not eligible for this position and should not apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers AS is Norway's largest camper van rental company, with locations in Tromsø and Oslo. We offer a wide range of custom-built camper vans, giving our guests the freedom to explore Norway's breathtaking landscapes at their own pace.

We are a young, dynamic, and international team made up of both locals and expats. We value teamwork, initiative, and a positive attitude, and we take pride in delivering outstanding service and unforgettable travel experiences.

description:

title: PhD fellowship - Computational Models for Improved Assessment of Diastolic Function
description:
A 3-year PhD-fellowship is available at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital. This is one out of two fellowships at The Intervention Centre that is part of the Cardiovascular Digital Twin network comprising a total of 15 fellowships across Europe (https://www.cdtnet.eu/). The project is funded by the European Research Council’s MSCA program.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Project and Job Description


Heart failure affects millions of people worldwide, and around half of all cases are linked to problems with the heart's ability to relax and fill properly during diastole. Although echocardiography is the most commonly used imaging technique for assessing cardiac function, many of the key factors responsible for diastolic dysfunction—such as myocardial stiffness, impaired relaxation, and elevated filling pressures—cannot be measured directly using current non-invasive methods.


This project aims to improve the assessment of diastolic function by combining echocardiographic measurements with patient-specific digital twin technology. The doctoral candidate will develop mathematical models that link clinically acquired echocardiographic data to the underlying physiological and mechanical properties of the heart. By integrating imaging information with computational models, the project seeks to estimate clinically important parameters that are otherwise difficult to measure without invasive procedures.


While the main focus of the project is the integration of conventional echocardiographic measurements with computational models of cardiac function, there will also be opportunities to investigate emerging ultrasound modalities such as blood speckle tracking (BST). BST provides information about intracardiac flow dynamics and can be used to derive parameters such as intraventricular pressure gradients, energy loss, and flow vortices. The clinical utility of these measurements and their relationship to filling pressures and diastolic function will be explored.


The candidate will participate in the collection and analysis of animal and clinical datasets, including echocardiographic studies with simultaneously recorded invasive pressure measurements. These data will be used to develop, calibrate, and validate the proposed modelling approaches. Ultimately, the project aims to create more accurate and clinically useful tools for diagnosing and monitoring heart failure, supporting earlier intervention and more personalised patient care.

The PhD-fellow will be based at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital where the work will be conducted in an interdisciplinary team of research scientists, surgeons, engineers, and university researchers. The employment period is three years (commencing approximately December 2026), including the objective of taking organized academic training (university courses) and the completion of the PhD degree. Admission to a doctoral degree program is a requirement; including undertaking a total of 30 credits coursework from University in Oslo’s (UiO) PhD courses. For regulations concerning the PhD degree at UiO, see: https://www.uio.no/english/research/phd

 

Planned Research stays


●        King's College London, United Kingdom (2 months): training in advanced cardiac digital twin and heart modelling technologies.
●        Maastricht University, Netherlands (1 month): training in the CircAdapt cardiovascular modelling platform and model personalisation methods.

  Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Desirable Project-Specific Qualifications and Skills

  • We seek a motivated, creative, and enthusiastic candidate with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of engineering, mathematics, and medicine.
  • Applicants should hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in Cybernetics, Electrical Engineering, Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Technology, or a related discipline.
  • A strong academic record is required with a weighted average grade of B or higher.
  • Experience with scientific programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, or similar languages) is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of mathematical modelling, computational mechanics, or data science is considered an advantage.
  • Interest in cardiovascular physiology, echocardiography, medical technology, or computational medicine is desirable.
  • Experience with experimental, pre-clinical, or clinical research, including data collection, validation studies, or analysis of biomedical data, is an advantage.
  • Previous research experience, including scientific publications, conference presentations, or research projects, is beneficial.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
  • The successful candidate should be able to work independently while also contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.

Important Eligibility Rule (MSCA Mobility Rule)

This position is funded by the European Research Council's MSCA program. To apply, you must meet a strict international mobility rule.

Who CANNOT apply: Anyone who has lived, worked, or studied in Norway for more than 12 months in total during the last 3 years.

Who CAN apply: Anyone who has spent less than 12 months in Norway during the last 3 years (including those who have never been to Norway).

We offer
  • Standard Norwegian PhD fellowship salary according to agreement with labour union
  • Professional development in a friendly and stimulating multi-disciplinary and international working environment
  • Attractive welfare arrangements

 

Application documents:

Short statement on the applicant’s personal qualifications and motivation for the position
Applicant's CV (including list of publications and relevant former positions)
Academic transcripts and degree certificates, with official translation in English
Short statement from a former supervisor/tutor/teacher

Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Ålesund kommune

Referansenr.: 5152923593
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Engasjement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, med ca. 60 000 innbyggere.

Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikke minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygget» på fiske og fangst. Fremdeles er Ålesundsregionen verdensledende innen det marine og maritime området. Flere av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskaper holder til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Norges største cruisehavn, største fiskerihavn og nest største containerhavn. Vi er også Norges største eksporthavn for fiskeprodukter.

Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tall fra 2016 viser at det årlig er rundt to millioner passasjerer som går av eller på en buss eller båt i Ålesund.

Ålesund by er vidt kjent for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykninger møter deg når du går gatelangs der. Byen ligger som en døråpner til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekker seg helt nord til Ona utenfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjoner i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjorder og natur rett utenfor stuedøren.

Vi er en universitetskommune og har et nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finner du også Ålesund framtidslab – U4SSC IP.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4 400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

title: PhD Position - Biochemical Bioprospecting of Macroalgae
description:
This is Nord University

Would you like to help create knowledge that makes a difference? At Nord University, we develop future solutions through education, research, and collaboration with the society around us.

Together, we shape the future with roots in the North and our eyes on what lies ahead.

Nord in the world - knowledge for the future.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KWoZi6o-EB4About the position

Faculty of Biosciences and Aquaculture, Nord University, Norway, invites applications from outstanding candidates for a three- or four-year PhD position in Macroalgal biochemical bioprospecting. 

This position offers the opportunity to explore the chemical diversity and biological activity of phenolic compounds from cold-adapted macroalgae. Using advanced analytical platforms, the candidate will be able to characterize these compounds, besides employing cell-lines/ model organisms to investigate their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties at the molecular level. The project supports the faculty’s translational research on chronic intestinal inflammation, a major health challenge in humans attributed to diet and other factors. The association of this disease condition with oxidative stress and dysregulated cellular processes creates interest not only in elucidating the underlying mechanisms, but also to explore the application of algae-derived compounds in conjunction with preventive health strategies. Macroalgae are a promising and sustainable source of phenolic compounds, and their biological activities have been demonstrated in different experimental systems. However, due to their chemical complexity and structural variability, their mode of biological action needs to be studied further. Phlorotannins typically occur as complex mixtures of structurally related compounds, while catechins are secondary metabolites occurring in bound and free forms, conjugated to cell wall polymers making their characterization and biological evaluation challenging. The candidate applying for the position should have adequate expertise either in analytical chemistry or possess advanced skills in molecular cell biology to undertake this applied research project

This research project, which is partly externally funded, is a collaboration between Nord University and NIBIO at their respective research divisions in Bodø, Norway, providing access to strong research environments, interdisciplinary supervision, and state‑of‑the‑art laboratory facilities.

Candidates must comply with Nord University’s residency requirements.


Qualification requirements
  • The ideal candidate for this position must possess an MSc degree in biosciences, biochemistry, cell biology or a discipline relevant for the announced position. A grade average of B or better (or equivalent score) is required for both the program overall and the master’s thesis to be admitted to the PhD program. Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must submit approval of their master’s degree, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education 
  • The ideal candidate would have undertaken a master’s thesis project on seaweed chemistry, and have a sound background on structure, diversity and ecological roles of compounds, particularly phlorotannins. Expertise in seaweed biomass handling and growing them under laboratory conditions, and sample preparation from the biomass for downstream analyses will be advantageous for the position. In addition, if a candidate has gained skills in analytical techniques, using HPLC, LC-MS, LC-MS/QTOF, or related platforms for phlorotannin characterization, this can be of significant benefit for conducting the PhD project
  • The candidate must have the ability to process, curate and interpret analytical data sets and prepare scientific publication. The candidate should also be able to work independently while collaborating effectively across disciplines. The candidate must be strong in scientific communication skills in English, across multiple platforms
  • See admission requirements:  PhD in Biosciences Employment is conditional upon admission to the faculty’s doctoral program. The final project proposal must be submitted within three months of appointment. Termination may be considered if admission to the doctoral program is not obtained within this deadline, or in cases of failure to submit annual progress reports and/or serious deficiencies in progress or duty work. For admission requirements and regulations, see our web page
  • It can be beneficial if the applicant masters Norwegian or a Scandinavian language
    For the position, good English skills are required both written and oral. The thesis must be written in English

Candidates who already have a PhD degree will not be considered for the position.


Qualified applicants will be ranked according to the following criteria:
  • Themes and perspectives from the applicant’s master’s study. Project outline with description of project idea and plan for implementation
  • The applicant’s description of motivation for the doctoral work and opportunities for completion
  • Relevant experience from research work
  • Ability to work independently, goal-oriented and systematically
  • Personal suitability

We offer

The annual salary for doctoral researchers (code 1017) is NOK 565 000,-.

  • Advantages within the Government Pension Fund for loans, insurance and pension
  • Creative and collegial working environment
  • A workplace with progressive development
  • Flexible working hours  
  • Active university sports team

General information

The state workforce should reflect the diversity of the population. Nord University therefore encourages qualified candidates with disabilities, gaps in their CV, an immigrant background, and otherwise diverse life experiences to apply.

Information regarding disabilities or gaps in a CV may be used for anonymized statistical purposes.

The person appointed must comply with the applicable laws, agreements, and directives. The responsibilities and duties associated with the position may change with future reorganization at Nord University.

Nord University is subject to the Security Act, which imposes requirements for the handling of protected and sensitive information. To enhance the security of recruitment processes, Nord may conduct background checks of relevant candidates. 
Security suitability will be considered.


Application process

Applicants will be evaluated by an internal expert committee. Relevant applicants will be invited for an interview, trial lecture or other presentations. For more information, see Nord`s website .

The Faculty reserves the right not to hire applicants who may be scientifically qualified, but who do not meet other criteria such as language, educational background or personal characteristics.


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically by 10.09.2026

The application should include:

  • Application letter with description of your motivation for applying for the position
  • Complete CV (education, work and teaching experience and overview of any scientific publications
  • A project description (maximum 3 pages), based on the theme mentioned earlier in this announcement, including the theoretical anchoring, methodological approaches, and a progress plan for the three-year fellowship period. If you have employed AI-powered generative language models to prepare the project description, a declaration must be included at the end of the document, stating the extent to which you have relied on such models.
  • Copy of diploma for both bachelor and master education and relevant certificates. Diplomas from outside the EU/EEA must submit approval of their master’s degree, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education
  • Copy of the applicant’s master’s thesis as a PDF file
  • Name and contact information of 2-3 references (name, your relation to the person, email and phone number)
  • Any other activity that is considered relevant for the position

All documents (only those asked for) must be uploaded as PDF attachments to the electronic application form.

It is the applicant's responsibility to submit the complete documentation within the deadline.

Once the application period has ended a list of applicants will be published. Note that, in special cases, the identity of particular applicants to a position may be made public even when that applicant has requested that their application be processed confidentially. Applicants requesting an exemption from publication of their identity must explain their reasons for doing so in their application. In this case, advance notice will be given in the event of a decision to make any information about the applicant public.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Through research, education and social engagement, Nord University contributes to the creation of a sustainable future.

In cooperation with society, business and industry in Northern and Central Norway, our 11,500 students and 1,350 staff promote innovative solutions and knowledge-based practice, both locally and internationally.

Nord University has four strategic focus areas: blue and green growth, sustainable innovation and entrepreneurship, societal security, and health, welfare and education.

Faculty of Biosciences and Aquaculture (FBA) educates people with the aim of promoting sustainable and innovative development to meet global challenges in food production, climate and environment. The faculty is an international arena for education, research and knowledge dissemination, with employees and students from 39 different countries. The faculty offers a PhD in Biosciences. FBA has 900 students and 165 employees in Bodø and Steinkjer. The professional community is organized into the following divisions: Aquaculture, Ecology, Genomics and Animal Science, Production and Welfare and Algae and microbial biotechnology.

title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Barnehagelærer
description:
Vi lyser ut et vikariat som barnehagelærer med tiltredelse snarest og varighet til 18.06.27. Med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi søker etter deg som er ambisiøs på vegne av barna, handlekraftig, omsetter teori til praksis, og som virkelig ønsker å skape en god barnehage til det beste for barnet og familien!  

Svanevågen søker Barnehagelærer vikariat – og kanskje er det deg?

Vi leter etter en trygg medarbeider som vet hvor stor forskjell én god relasjon kan gjøre. En som har hjertet på rett sted, hodet fullt av fag, og som drives av å gjøre barnas verden rikere – gjennom omsorg, utforsking og engasjement. Som vi sier i våre verdier: En som er kompetent og nyskapende med et stort hjerte til det beste for barnet.

Hva kan du forvente hos oss? Du får bli en del av et lag med høy faglig puls og et stort hjerte. Vi gir deg:

Et varmt og inkluderende kollegafellesskap

  • Veiledning og faglig utvikling fra første dag

  • Et arbeidsmiljø som tar forskning på alvor og setter kunnskap ut i livet

  • Nettverk med 3000 Norlandia

  • Kolleger over hele landet

  • Anstendig lønn og pensjon og eget fordelsprogram

  • Ekstra støtte til nyutdannede

  • En hverdag fylt med variasjon, lek og ekte øyeblikk

Vi tror du lykkes hos oss hvis du:

  • Brenner for å skape trygge relasjoner og god barndom

  • Liker å være tilgjengelig for barna, responsiv og deltakende

  • Villig til å omsette pedagogisk teori til praksis bygget på systematikk

  • Ser betydningen av kvalitet og omsetter observasjon og refleksjon over egen praksis til trening og handling

  • Støtter barns lek og læring med sensitivitet og varme

  • Bidrar til et alderstilpasset pedagogisk innhold med fokus på tidlig stimulering, lek og læring

  • Faglig engasjert, profesjonell og setter barnets beste først

Hvem er vi i Norlandia Barnehagene?

Vi er en barnehagekjede som tør å tenke nytt. Vi jobber systematisk med kvalitet, og bruker CLASS som verktøy for å styrke relasjonen mellom barn og voksne. Vi er kunnskapsdrevne, varme og opptatt av at alle barn – uansett bakgrunn – skal få en barndom preget av mestring, trygghet og glede.

Formelle kvalifikasjonskrav

• Treårig høgskoleutdanning som barnehagelærer eller annen treårig pedagogisk utdanning på høgskolenivå med videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk

• Godkjent utdanning fra Utdanningsdirektoratet.

• Utenlandske søkere må ha Bergenstest/B2 og godkjent utdanning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse - https://hkdir.no/utdanning-frautlandet

• Godkjent politiattest (ikke eldre enn 3 måneder) må vises ved tiltredelse (ref. barnehageloven §30)

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli intervjuet fortløpende, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før annonsen utløper.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.

title: Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact

description:
Who we are

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 50 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

Who you are

As a senior leader, the Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact will play an important role in shaping the organisation’s strategic direction, strengthening collaboration across teams and supporting the culture of trust, accountability and high performance.  The role includes leading multiple workstreams and teams across the Secretariat.

This position brings together strategy development, strategic communications, monitoring, evaluation, learning and impact. Reporting to the Executive Director, the role will work closely with the Board Chair and Senior Management Team to strengthen EITI’s external influence and evidence-based impact narrative.

As a member of the Senior Management Team, the successful applicant will contribute to organisational decision-making, planning, delivery and finance.

The EITI International Secretariat’s values are Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity. The successful applicant will identify with and demonstrate behaviours consistent with these values. Personal suitability for the position, including alignment with the EITI values, will be a decisive factor in the selection process. 


Duties and responsibilities
  • Coordinate strategy development and provide strategic updates to the Board and Senior Management Team.
  • Embed strategic priorities in resourcing, work planning and impact measurement.
  • Coordinate updates to the Secretariat’s risk matrix and mitigating actions.
  • Provide strategic leadership for EITI communications channels and outputs.
  • Oversee implementation of the EITI communications strategy.
  • Lead development of high-level speeches, media engagement, crisis communications and statements.
  • Ensure quality assurance across blogs, news, newsletters and flagship publications.
  • Support effective communication of Board decisions by the Chair and Executive Director.
  • Oversee MEL, KPIs, results frameworks and evidence gathering to demonstrate impact.
  • Identify opportunities to increase visibility of EITI outcomes, through targeted communication materials.  
  • Contribute actively to Senior Management Team discussions on strategy, delivery, finance and organisational priorities.
  • Management and oversight of Communication and MEL work streams.
Qualifications
  • Senior leadership experience in complex international organisations.
  • Proven experience in strategy development, communications and MEL.
  • Ability to translate strategic priorities into organisational action and delivery.
  • Strong judgement in managing competing priorities, complexity and organisational risk.
  • Track record of leading communications in an international organisation.
  • Strong understanding of media networks and strategic use of social media.
  • Experience with engaging senior stakeholders across government, industry, civil society and development partners.
  • Ability to represent an organisation in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with a commitment to inclusion, accountability and collaboration.
  • First-hand knowledge and senior-level experience of working in low- and middle-income countries in the non-profit sector. 
  • Strong commitment to the pursuit of transparency, accountability, and good governance in the extractive sector globally. 
  • A first degree in a relevant social science subject or related discipline. A post-graduate qualification is desirable.
  • Fluency in English. Competence in one or more of the official languages of the EITI is desirable.
We can offer

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change.

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, an attractive benefits and above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.

The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests an annual range starting at 1,120,000 NOK. Placement within the senior leadership salary range will be determined in accordance with the organisation’s internal salary policy. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget, work location, and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

Our preference is for this role to be based in Oslo, alongside other members of the Senior Management Team. Exceptional candidates may also be considered on a remote-working basis, provided that their location does not prevent them from fully engaging in the day-to-day work of the Secretariat and travelling to Oslo when required by organisational needs. Relocation support may be provided in accordance with the Secretariat’s internal relocation policy.

Email applications will not be processed.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) is the global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources.

Guided by the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the EITI has established a global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources. The EITI Standard requires the disclosure of information along the extractive industry value chain from the point of extraction, to how revenues make their way through the government, and how they benefit the public. By doing so, the EITI seeks to strengthen public and corporate governance, promote understanding of natural resource management, and provide the data to inform reforms for greater transparency and accountability in the extractives sector. In each of the 55 implementing countries, the EITI is supported by a coalition of government, companies, and civil society.

The EITI is committed to achieving diversity in terms of gender, nationality, culture and educational background. The EITI is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Helt om natta, og helt om dagen!
description:
Trives du i en aktiv hverdag med mye utfordringer og variasjon i arbeidet? Setter du sikkerhet og folka først? 

Vi i Ramudden ser nå etter flinke trafikkmedarbeidere som kan hjelpe oss å vokse videre å møte etterspørselen fra våre kunder i tiden fremover.

Vi bistår våre kunder med alt innenfor trafikksikkerhet, og du vil få mulighet til å være tett på både små og store vei-, vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter i hele Innlandet fylke. 

Typiske oppgaver kan være:

  • Trafikkdirigering
  • Ledebilkjøring
  • Forvarslingsvogn
  • Transportoppdrag
  • Montering av midlertidig sikring
  • Skilting

Vi har også monteringsoppdrag tilknyttet bygg, anlegg, tunneldrift og ulike vakt- og beredskapsoppdrag. Vi er også ofte involvert i større publikumsarrangementer i området, så her er det stor variasjon og ingen dag er lik! 

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn og utdanning, og har ingen konkrete krav til deg som søker utover at du tar sikkerhet på alvor, og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og lovverk som sikrer at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss er for mange et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, hvor du må være bevisst ansvaret og rollen du har når det kommer til sikkerheten på norske veier. Vi lærer deg alt du trenger å kunne, men den gode holdningen og profesjonelle atferden, den har du med deg i sekken fra før av. 

Eksempler på ulike bakgrunner du har kan være fra:

  • Kundeservice
  • Logistikk
  • Bygg & anlegg
  • Drift og vedlikehold
  • Undervisning
  • Praktisk og/eller teknisk bakgrunn
  • Andre fagområder

Er du pensjonist og har lyst til å være aktiv, sosial og en del av Ramuddenlaget, så søk gjerne hos oss!

Kompetansekrav:

  • Førerkort klasse B som minimum. BE og gjerne klasse C, men det er ikke et krav
  • Bestå AVK 1 og 3 (ikke som krav før ansettelse, men du må bestå dette for å kunne jobbe ute på veien) 
  • Av sikkerhetsårsaker og dokumentasjonskrav, må du kunne kommunisere godt på norsk muntlig og skriftlig 
  • Benytte telefon og ulike digitale systemer i din arbeidshverdag

Som person er du forhåpentligvis; 

  • en med godt humør som smitter over på både kunder og kolleger
  • teknisk og praktisk anlagt
  • en som trives med å omgås og kommunisere med andre mennesker
  • en god lagspiller som vil bidra til et godt og trygt arbeidsmiljø
  • strukturert og nøye, og kan tilfredsstille høye krav til dokumentasjon av arbeidet
  • fokusert på arbeid, og forstår viktigheten av å sette sikkerheten foran alt annet 
  • generelt god helse og fysikk som tillater deg å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb 
  • Gode videreutviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden lokalt og nasjonalt 
  • Fleksibilitet i rollen, dette passer deg som lever et liv hvor du ikke er avhengig av å jobbe 8-16
  • 30-60 % stilling 

 

Vi skal ansette opptil 10 nye kolleger, og håper at den ene er deg! 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: Elektriker
description:
Vil du være med og sikre at noen av regionens viktigste bygg fungerer hver eneste dag?

Stavanger kommune forvalter distriktets største og mest varierte eiendomsportefølje – fra skoler, barnehager og helsebygg til kulturbygg, bydelshus og historiske eiendommer i gamle Stavanger. Hos oss får du jobbe med en av landets mest spennende bygningsporteføljer, i et fagmiljø som stadig vokser i takt med økende tekniske krav.

Seksjon Byggdrift, som ligger under Bymiljø og utbygging (avdeling Eiendom), består av enhetene Renhold, Drift, Fag og Bolig. Seksjonen har ansvar for daglig drift og vedlikehold av kommunens bygg og boliger, og jobber tett opp mot brukere, tjenester og kommunens øvrige fagmiljøer.

Nå styrker vi laget og søker deg som har teknisk kompetanse, serviceinnstilling og et ønske om å bidra til trygge og godt fungerende bygg for innbyggere og ansatte.

Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å:

  • Arbeide i et fagmiljø med sterk kompetanse og høy aktivitet
  • Bidra til kvalitet, framdrift og godt samarbeid på tvers av fag
  • Sikre at oppdrag blir utført med riktig kvalitet, koordinering og dokumentasjon
  • Følge opp tekniske installasjoner, drift, avvik og servicearbeid
  • Sørge for at lover, forskrifter og interne standarder blir etterlevd
  • Skape gode opplevelser for brukere, ansatte, samarbeidspartnere og oppdragsgivere

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å jobbe i et profesjonelt miljø med stort ansvar og tydelig samfunnsnytte. Her er det rom for utvikling, spesialisering og å være med på å forme framtidens kommunale byggdrift.  


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kvalitetssikre avvik og utbedre feil/ mangler
  • Utførelse av arbeidsoppgaver for Fagenheten
  • Reparasjon og test i verkstedavdeling
  • Være en god kollega, være åpen, inkluderende og aktivt ivareta arbeidsmiljø 
  • Utvikling av fagområder
  • Ansvar for at oppgaver gjennomføres/ dokumenteres iht. gjeldene lover og forskrifter
  • Være en rollemodell
  • Aktivt delta i utvikling og forbedring
  • Utstrakt samarbeid med fagleder, faggruppene og virksomhetene
  • Rapportere til Gruppeleder
  • Dele kompetanse og læring  
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagarbeider skal ha fagbrev som elektriker Gr.L
  • Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE

Arbeidsspråket i Stavanger kommune er norsk. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språkferdigheter tilsvarende B1. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål. 

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er nær og inkluderende, tar vare på dine kolleger, samarbeidspartnere og innbyggernes behov
  • Du er åpen for andres kunnskap, ønsker å lære og deler av din kunnskap
  • Du er nyskapende og utviklingsorientert, utforsker nye muligheter og løsninger, tør å prøve og feile, evner å forandre for å forbedre
  • Du er profesjonell og har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Du er selvstendig og strukturert, løsningsorientert og tenker helhetlig på tvers av sektorer og fag
  • Du har gjennomføringskraft og evner å prioritere
  • Du har god IT-kompetanse og systemforståelse
  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, bærekraftige løsninger og gode økonomiske resultater 
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte og meningsfulle prosjekter i en av regionens mest spennende og komplekse eiendomsporteføljer
  • Et sterkt og støttende fagmiljø der vi løfter hverandre, deler kompetanse og spiller hverandre gode
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet kombinert med ansvarsfulle og utviklende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med kolleger som har solid erfaring, høy faglighet og et ekte engasjement for bygg og tekniske tjenester
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Arbeidstid etter avtale
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig – vi tilrettelegger for at du lykkes og når dine karrieremål
  • Lønn etter: Stillingskode: 751714

Vi ber om at godkjente vitnemål/karakterutskrifter og attester lastes opp som vedlegg til den elektroniske søknaden. Vi søker hotellmedarbeider!

Vi søker deg som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag med housekeeping og frokostservering. Du er nøyaktig, serviceinnstilt og trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team. Erfaring fra hotell er en fordel, men riktig innstilling er viktigst.

Vi ser etter deg som er positiv, pålitelig og serviceinnstilt, og som liker å skape gode opplevelser for andre. Du tar ansvar, ser hva som må gjøres og kan arbeide selvstendig, samtidig som du trives som en del av et team.

Du møter både gjester og kollegaer med respekt og et smil, er fleksibel når dagen ikke går helt som planlagt og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra første dag. Erfaring fra hotell, housekeeping eller servering er en fordel, men motivasjon, arbeidsvilje og riktig innstilling er viktigere. Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å lære, utvikle seg og vokse sammen med oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hotellmedarbeider -- Housekeeping & Frokost

Vi søker en positiv og fleksibel hotellmedarbeider som vil være med på å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil hovedsakelig være:

  • Rengjøring og klargjøring av hotellrom og fellesarealer

  • Skifte av sengetøy og håndklær

  • Kontroll av rom før gjestenes ankomst

  • Klargjøring og servering av frokost

  • Påfyll og rydding av frokostbuffet

  • Oppvask og rengjøring av kjøkken og frokostområde

  • Møte gjestene på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte

  • Bidra der det er behov i den daglige hotelldriften

Vi ser etter deg som er nøyaktig, effektiv, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt. Du må kunne arbeide både selvstendig og sammen med andre. Arbeidet innebærer vakter på morgener, hverdager og helger.

Krav:
30 sekunders personlig video

Vi vil gjerne bli litt bedre kjent med deg!

Send oss en kort video på maks. 30 sekunder hvor du forteller:

Hvorfor ønsker du å jobbe hos Lyngen North, og hva tror du at du kan bidra med i teamet vårt?

Videoen trenger ikke å være profesjonell -- bruk mobilen og vær deg selv. Vi er først og fremst nysgjerrige på personen bak søknaden.

  • Du må kunne kommunisere godt på engelsk

  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav

Erfaring fra hotell, housekeeping eller servering er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For oss er riktig innstilling, ansvarsfølelse og ønsket om å gi gjestene god service det viktigste.

Vi tilbyr

  • Lønn i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale

  • Mulighet for bolig

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende team

  • Et internasjonalt og spennende arbeidsmiljø

  • En variert arbeidshverdag med ulike oppgaver

  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg og få erfaring fra hotell- og reiselivsbransjen

  • En arbeidsplass der samarbeid, service og gode gjesteopplevelser står i fokus

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lyngen North er en unik reiselivsdestinasjon i Nord-Norge, vakkert plassert ved Lyngenfjorden med spektakulær utsikt mot Lyngsalpene. Vi tilbyr overnatting i eksklusive glassigloer, suiter og hytter, kombinert med restaurant og arktiske aktiviteter.

Våre gjester kommer fra hele verden for å oppleve nordlyset, midnattssolen, naturen, stillheten og ekte nordnorske opplevelser. Hos oss står personlig service og gode gjesteopplevelser i sentrum.

Lyngen North er en internasjonal arbeidsplass med et engasjert team fra flere land. Vi jobber tett sammen på tvers av housekeeping, restaurant, kjøkken, aktiviteter og gjesteservice. Hos oss blir du en del av et miljø med høyt tempo, varierte arbeidsdager og fantastiske omgivelser.

title: We are looking for a new Marketing Performance Analyst

title: Incorporating distribution grids in multiscale stochastic energy system models
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0Background - PhD Candidate at FME SecurEL – Incorporating distribution grids in multiscale stochastic energy system models  

There is a temporary PhD position for 3 years available at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management – Section Health, Safety and Environmental Management. The position is resident at NTNUs campus in Trondheim. This is an educational position, which will provide promising research recruits the opportunity for professional development through studies towards a PhD-degree. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management and the faculty will be your employer.

The PhD position will be part of FME SecurEL. The Centre will facilitate a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. See https://securel.no/ 


About the centre

The PhD position will be part of FME SecurEL. The Centre will facilitate a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. See https://securel.no/ 

SecurEL is a Centre for Environment-friendly Energy Research, facilitating a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. SecurEL aims to develop new knowledge addressing research challenges arising from accelerated electrification and increased use of the existing grid. Reaching these goals requires strong interdisciplinary collaboration among research institutions, user partners, and experts with diverse areas of expertise.

The Centre brings together experts from fields such as electrical engineering, energy systems, information and communication technology, cybersecurity, engineering cybernetics, industrial economics, as well as humanities and social sciences, to develop effective solutions for the power grid. SecurEL is a consortium of 42 partners, including 7 research partners. The centre period is 2025-2032, and the total budget is 398 million Norwegian kroner (NOK). NTNU is represented as a partner mainly by the Department of Electric Energy (IEL) and the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT).

Recruitment and research education is an important part of the mission of SecurEL. The PhD candidates funded by the Centre will contribute with cutting-edge knowledge and research. Overall, the Centre will directly finance 17 PhD and postdoc positions, and also have several associated PhDs from closely related projects. As a SecurEL-funded PhD candidate, you will be employed by NTNU, a university partner in the Centre, and take active part in the research activities. Through the Centre, you will have access to a forum with other PhD candidates affiliated with the Centre, and opportunities for research stays with partners, both nationally and abroad, through its international network.

Read more about the Centre and its research at the website https://www.securel.no/.   


About the position

Energy system models are widely used by researchers and analysts for investigating how policies and technology developments may impact our energy futures. These models often cover large geographical areas, several energy carriers and sometimes also multiple time scales. Therefore, it is unavoidable to make trade-offs between modelling detail and computational efficiency/tractability. Local energy resources and demands are typically aggregated to country-level, while local constraints, such as distribution grids, are usually not considered at all. However, with the changing energy landscape with increasing focus on distributed assets and flexibility, the role of the power grid, and more directly the distribution grid, becomes more critical. To account for the changes seen in the power grid in long-term investment planning, we need to understand how the development of power grid impacts the long-term investments and operation of the whole energy system.    

Therefore, this PhD will contribute to the field by exploring new methods and modelling frameworks for inclusion of power grids, with a focus on distribution grids and distributed resources in multiscale energy system models with a special focus on capturing security of supply aspects of the distribution grid in the energy system modelling. The models may be multiscale in the time dimension including for example investments (years), operations (hours) and balancing (minutes). The models may also be multiscale in the geographical resolution by representing the spatial location as a country (Norway), while other locations are modelled in detail with physical location of distributed generation and grids.  The modeling framework should be stochastic to represent variations in demand and renewable generation.  

Methodologically, the project will be based on novel models and decomposition methods for multiscale stochastic problems. Examples of relevant methods may be Stochastic Dual Dynamic Programming, Alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) composition and similar decomposition approaches. We are searching for candidates that have interest both in energy systems and power system modeling, and that are familiarized with optimization methods.   

The project will be a cooperation between NTNU, SINTEF, IFE as well as the industrial partnership of the FME SecurEL.  

You will report to your supervisor. 


Duties of the position
  • Execute a PhD project within 3 years (including obtaining own data for research, analysis and dissemination). 
  • Plan and execute the empirical work and data collection targeted to address the research objectives. 
  • Complete the necessary doctoral coursework as per NTNU’s guidelines.
  • Attend project meetings and develop a collaboration network with project partners.
  • Disseminate research findings through national/international academic conferences and open access scientific journals that meet the requirements for the PhD position.

Required selection criteria
  • The PhD-position's main objective is to qualify for work in research positions. The qualification requirement is completion of a master’s degree or second degree (equivalent to 120 credits) in operations research and optimization or equivalent education. Applicants should have a strong academic background with a grade of B or better in terms of NTNU’s grading scale. Applicants with no letter grades from previous studies must have an equally good academic foundation.  
  • The position requires excellent English oral and writing skills. 

Preferred selection criteria

In addition, the following qualifications will contribute positively to the evaluation of the applicant:

  • Background and/or experience relevant to the project topic  
  • Scandinavian language skills
  • Documented experience with stochastic optimization
  • Documented experience with energy system analysis 
  • Good knowledge of digital tools like Julia, Python, etc.  

Personal characteristics
  • A high level of personal responsibility and initiative
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in accordance with the project objectives
  • Ability to work in interdisciplinary projects and teams
  • Suitable candidates should have good communication skills, be flexible and solution-oriented

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in the advertisement.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment 
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • As a public employee, you have favourable benefits as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

You will be employed as a PhD Candidate at NTNU and will have access to employee benefits and discounts. 

Information about Working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: http://www.nyinorge.no/en/Ny-i-Norge-velg-sprak/New-in-Norway/


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

PhD candidates are remunerated in code 1017, at gross NOK 536.200,- per annum before tax. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period. Your work place will be at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)for general criteria for the position.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

The position is subject to external funding.
For the necessary academic and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.


About the application

The application and supporting documentation to be used as the basis for the assessment must be in English. Publications and other scientific work must follow the application. Please note that your application will be considered based solely on information submitted by the application deadline. You must therefore ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experience fulfil the criteria specified above. Incomplete applications will not be considered. 

1)    Application letter concerning your motivation for completing a PhD
2)    A CV with information on education, previous research experience, together with authorized documentation of certificates and study records. 
3)    Academic work (not master thesis). Joint work will be evaluated. If it is difficult to identify the contributions from individuals in a joint piece of work, applicants should enclose a short descriptive summary of what she/he contributed to the work. 
4)    Name and address of three references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI). 

If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well. 
In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates. 

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

Please submit your application electronically via jobbnorge.no with your CV, diplomas and certificates. Applications submitted elsewhere will not be considered.


General information

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the innovation capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard email Asgeir.tomasgard@ntnu.no or phone + 47 930 58 771.  If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Hilde Selli Egelie, e-mail: hilde.s.egelie@ntnu.no.

title: Tilkallingsvikarer i Steinkjerskolene skoleåret 2026/2027
description:
Steinkjer kommune har 14 grunnskoler og Voksenopplæring.
Vi søker lære med lærerutdanning, basisfag i grunnskole og voksenopplæring med de kompetansekrav for undervisning som opplæringsloven har satt.

  • Lønn, lesetid og arbeidsvilkår i følge lov, forskrift, instruks og regulativ.
  • Fagarbeider og assistenter til vikaroppdrag i skole og SFO
  • Miljøarbeidere til vikaroppdrag i skolene.

Søknaden legges i sektor skole sin vikarliste. Den enkelte skole vil ta kontakt ved behov.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Tilkallingsvikar i skole
  • Kortere vikariater ved behov
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Bør ha lærerutdanning 
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
  • Krav om godkjent politiattest

De som ansettes som lærere i Steinkjer kommune skal ha lærerutdanning. Alle som tilsettes som lærer må påregne å undervise i basisfag og da kreves det 30 stp for barnetrinn og 60stp for ungdomstrinn. 

Personlige egenskaper

Steinkjerskolene trenger vikarer med følgende personlige egenskaper:

  • Er dyktig, engasjert og utviklingsorientert
  • Har god faglig, pedagogisk og didaktisk kompetanse
  • Har evne til å bygge gode relasjoner 
  • Er en god og tydelig klasseleder
  • Er tilpasningsdyktig til nye klasser og skoler
Vi tilbyr
  • Innmelding i Statens pensjonskasse, for undervisningspersonale/lærere
  • Innmelding i KLP for andre stillinger i skole
  • Arbeidstiden er gjennomsnittsberegnet og følger skoleåret.
  • Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i h.h.t. lov, forskrifter og avtaleverk.
  • Tilsetting skjer på gode kommunale vilkår.
  • Tilsettingen er betinget av at det framlegges politiattest i samsvar med opplæringslovens § 10-9.
KontaktinformasjonGisle Kristian Almlid-Larsen, Sektorleder oppvekst
ArbeidsstedKongens Gate 39
7713 Steinkjer
