Den här tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad så därför kommer vi att göra en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll innan vi fattar beslut om anställning.

Hos oss är alla medarbetares kompetens och potential viktig. Vi tror på en inkluderande kultur där vi drar nytta av vår mångfald och våra olikheter. Du som söker delar våra förhållningssätt: mod att agera, tillit till varandras kompetens och goda vilja, handlingskraft att omsätta ord i arbete och var och ens ansvar att bidra till helheten.

Du ansöker genom att registrera ditt CV på svenska. Bifoga ditt examensbevis med kursförteckning. Krav på akademiska poäng som inte ingår i en examen ska verifieras genom studieintyg/registerutdrag. I din ansökan får du besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor i vårt rekryteringssystem som du kommer till när du klickar på Ansök nedan. Vid denna rekrytering kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter, vänligen kontakta HR-partner via SCB:s växel.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Smart Eye is leading the global market for Driver Monitoring Systems, which has become a standard component in every car. Monitoring the driver behavior is safety critical both for normal driving as well as for autonomous driving. We are constantly growing and are now looking for a Senior Project Managers who want to join our team.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of advanced Interior Sensing software programs for global automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. This role serves as the primary interface between customers and internal cross-functional teams, ensuring customer commitments are met while maintaining alignment with company priorities, technical capabilities, and business objectives. You bring structure and clarity to complex automotive software programs while helping teams navigate uncertainty and change.

You will be leading one or more of our developer teams, communicating with the customers and other internal stakeholders as well as setting the priorities for the team.

Responsibilities:

Customer Program Leadership

    Act as the primary program management contact for assigned OEM and Tier-1 customers, leading meetings, reviews, milestones, and issue resolution.
    Build trusted customer relationships and manage expectations while balancing internal resources and business priorities.
    Ensure clear alignment between customer requirements, commitments, and internal execution.

Program Planning & Execution

    Develop and manage program plans, schedules, deliverables, risks, budgets, and customer commitments.
    Coordinate cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product Owners, Validation, Data Management, and Customer Support.
    Proactively identify execution risks and resource conflicts, driving mitigation and timely delivery of releases, demos, and evaluations.

Risk & Issue Management

    Proactively identify, communicate, and manage program risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
    Lead customer escalations and drive timely, solution-oriented resolution of issues.
    Facilitate decision-making and ensure closure of critical actions.

Requirements & Change Management

    Coordinate customer requirements, feature requests, and change requests together with Product and Sales.
    Assess impact on scope, schedule, and resources, ensuring commitments and changes are documented and communicated.
    Support configuration management and release planning.

Communication & Reporting

    Provide clear and concise program status updates to customers and internal leadership.
    Translate complex technical topics into business-oriented communication.
    Maintain executive-level reporting and program documentation covering status, risks, opportunities, and key decisions.

Your qualifications:

    At least Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technical Management, or a related field.
    5+ years of automotive project/program management, including customer-facing software development programs.
    Proven experience working with OEM and Tier-1 customers and managing multiple complex projects.
    Strong understanding of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.
    Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    Ability to perform effectively in fast-paced customer environments and proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar.

Interviews are held on a continuous basis, so we highly recommend that you submit your application at your earliest convenience. Welcome with your application.

Smart Eye is the global leader in Human Insight AI, technology that understands, supports and predicts human behavior in complex environments. Together with our subsidiaries Affectiva and iMotions, we are bridging the gap between humans and machines for a safe and sustainable future.

Today, our technology is embedded in next-generation vehicles, leading the way towards human-centric mobility through Driver Monitoring Systems and Interior Sensing solutions. Our Research Instruments offer unparalleled insights into automotive, aviation, assistive technology, behavioral science and many more fields.

Visit www.smarteye.ai for more information.

title: Risk Manager
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a key role in a regulated financial environment where risk, capital and reporting are central to business decisions. The focus is on strengthening risk management capabilities across regulatory development, capital monitoring and ICAAP, while also supporting ongoing initiatives tied to risk classification and reporting.

This is a hands-on role for you who enjoy combining analysis, governance and regulatory interpretation. You will work close to important financial risk topics such as credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses, and help turn complex data and regulations into practical decision support. It is a great opportunity if you want to work with high-impact risk topics in a setting where your expertise will influence both compliance and business steering.

Job Description

    You will identify, assess and monitor financial risks, with a primary focus on credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses.
    You will drive analysis related to portfolio performance, capital requirements and profitability, and provide data-driven insights that support portfolio steering, capital efficiency and risk-adjusted business decisions.
    You will contribute to ICAAP work and support capital monitoring activities tied to regulatory requirements and internal risk management.
    You will support ongoing projects connected to risk classification processes and reporting, helping improve structure, quality and consistency.
    You will perform quality controls to ensure that risk data is accurate, complete and consistent.
    You will help develop and strengthen data governance and analytical capabilities that support business needs, regulatory compliance and scalable risk processes.
    You will contribute to the interpretation and implementation of regulatory frameworks and guidelines, including CRR/CRD and IFRS 9.

Requirements

    Experience working as a Risk Manager or in a similar role within financial risk management.
    Strong knowledge of credit risk, capital adequacy and IFRS 9 expected credit losses.
    Experience writing ICAAP and supporting capital monitoring.
    Ability to analyse portfolio performance, capital requirements and profitability, and translate findings into decision support.
    Experience performing quality controls of risk data and working with data accuracy, completeness and consistency.
    Ability to contribute to regulatory interpretation and implementation, including CRR/CRD and IFRS 9 requirements.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Jeppesen Foreflight is one of the largest software development companies in Gothenburg. We develop and implement innovative resource management and optimization solutions for the world’s leading airlines. We are dedicated to continuous improvement and delivering more value to our clients.

At Jeppesen’s office in central Gothenburg you will work in a one-of-a-kind software development organization with solutions that make a real difference to people around the world. You will be working in an agile learning organization, surrounded by a team of talented, creative and dedicated colleagues. You will learn and broaden your perspective by working with 400 professionals from more than 50 different nations, but also be part of a global organization allowing for collaboration with customers and colleagues across the world. Most importantly, you will be expected to make a difference.

Jeppesen is looking for a DevOps engineer for our Digital Solutions & Analytics implementation department based in Gothenburg, Sweden. As DevOps engineer you will be a member of a completely new team that will support our internal implementation projects with managing their configuration environments, build pipelines and related tools – all with the aim that the implementation projects can work as efficiently as possible.

Besides managing the projects configuration environments and support the projects, the other part of the teams focus is in the area of cooperation with out product development team further developing the configuration environment component, working together with them to add improvements and other activities that will ensure that operation problems are not only addressed short-term but mitigated at core.

As this is a new team we are looking for persons that are curious, not afraid to reach out to other teams for guidance / support but also is not afraid to take the lead and define the Ways Of Working for this new team.

Parts of the implementation teams are running the configuration environment on internal virtual servers while others are running them within an AWS cloud. Long-term we are looking at gradually migrating all the teams configuration environments into the cloud. Based on this both experience for VM / server based deployments as well as cloud based deployments using kubernetes are required.

Experience and Qualifications

We are looking for a candidate with the following experience and qualifications:

    5+ years of professional experience in a relevant technical role
    Strong experience providing DevOps support
    Proficiency in Python
    Experience with RHEL and RPM-based deployments
    Hands-on experience with cloud container technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes
    Experience working in AWS environments
    Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD pipelines
    Experience with GitHub Workflows and GitHub Actions
    Experience working with Oracle and PostgreSQL databases
    Advanced command of English, both written and verbal

Required Qualifications

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field
    Experience with VS Code extensions
    Experience with test automation using Behave and Gherkin
    Experience with RST documentation
    Experience with Jeppesen Crew or Operations Planning applications

Relocation:

    This position does not offer relocation. Candidates must live in the immediate area of Gothenburg or relocate at their own expense.
    Please apply by sending your CV in English.

Why You Should Join:

At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees and empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide employees and their loved ones with a world-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Our benefits package includes but is not limited to the following:

    Medical Insurance
    Employer paid life, AD&D, and long term disability insurance
    Health and wellness reimbursement allowance
    Pension plan
    30 paid vacation days, as well as additional days off for Christmas break
    Employee assistance program
    2 days off to volunteer annually
    Employee referral program
    Flight rewards and flight stipend

title: Senior Project Manager HR Transformation
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will lead a strategic HR transformation in a global automotive environment where the focus is on streamlining and globalizing HR capabilities and processes. The assignment combines business change and technology change, with a clear goal: move toward global target solutions while phasing out existing systems without disrupting critical HR services.

In this role, you create structure and momentum across several interconnected workstreams. You will align business and technology, manage dependencies and challenge plans and deliverables to keep quality, pace and productivity high. You will work closely with stakeholders across HR, IT, enterprise architecture, global functions and vendors. It is an exciting opportunity if you enjoy leading complex transformation with broad impact on both ways of working and system landscape.

Job Description

    You will lead and coordinate the transformation across multiple workstreams and drive the transition from current solutions to the target landscape.
    You will develop and maintain the overall roadmap, priorities, milestones, dependencies and delivery plan.
    You will set clear expectations for stream leads and challenge plans, deliverables, timelines and ownership where needed.
    You will identify cross-stream dependencies, risks and blockers, and drive decisions and resolution forward.
    You will lead implementation, migration and decommissioning activities tied to HR capabilities and processes.
    You will own the change management and communication strategy, with focus on stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness and adoption.
    You will guide and support Change & Communication resources in executing the strategy and help raise the quality of their output.
    You will ensure solid planning for data, integrations, testing, cutover, business continuity and transition to BAU.
    You will maintain effective governance and provide clear reporting and decision support to sponsors and steering committees.
    You will drive collaboration across business, technology and external partners to keep the program aligned and moving.

Requirements

    Significant experience leading large-scale business and technology transformation programs.
    Experience from at least two comparable transformations involving enterprise system implementation, migration and/or decommissioning at scale.
    Strong background in both project and program management, including leadership across multiple workstreams.
    Experience with process standardization, globalization or capability transformation in a complex organisation.
    Experience developing and evaluating business cases and translating business needs into clear scope, priorities and decisions.
    Strong experience in developing and leading change management and communication strategies within large-scale transformation programs.
    Experience with HR systems, particularly HRIS, and a good understanding of HR processes, payroll, data and integrations.
    Experience in change management, including stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, adoption and transition.
    Sufficient technical understanding to engage with and constructively challenge architects and specialists.
    Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct line-management authority.
    Ability to quickly understand complex environments, get up to speed and create clarity and momentum.
    English is required.

Nice to have

    Experience with global HR transformation.
    Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or similar HR platforms.
    Experience with payroll and time management.
    Experience with complex integrations and legacy-system decommissioning.
    Experience from large international organisations.

title: Senior Application Consultant
description:

We’re looking for a Senior Application Consultant with hands-on development skills in the Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem. You’ll be responsible for designing robust solutions, mentoring developers, and ensuring high-quality technical delivery across Dynamics 365 projects.

This role combines strategic thinking with practical implementation, ideal for someone who enjoys both architecting systems and getting their hands dirty with code.

Strong C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript and Power Platform experience.

Proven experience in solution design, data modeling, and system integration (Azure Functions, Service Bus, REST APIs, etc.).

Experience mentoring and guiding technical teams in agile environments.

Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure cloud services.

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. title: Senior Project Manager – Global HR Transformation
description:
The client is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager consultant to lead a strategic HR transformation program focused on modernizing and strengthening global HR capabilities.

The program aims to standardize and streamline HR processes globally, transition toward strategic and scalable global solutions, and phase out legacy systems while ensuring continuity of critical HR services.

The Senior Project Manager will lead multiple interconnected workstreams, align business and technology stakeholders, manage dependencies, risks and priorities, and constructively challenge plans and deliverables to ensure quality, pace and productivity.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and coordinate a complex HR transformation program across multiple workstreams, driving the transition from current systems and processes to the future-state landscape and agreed business outcomes.

    

Define and maintain the overall program roadmap, including priorities, key milestones, dependencies, timelines and delivery plans.

    

Provide clear direction to workstream leads, establish accountability, and constructively challenge plans, timelines and deliverables to ensure effective execution.

    

Proactively identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies, risks and blockers, facilitating timely decisions and resolution of issues.

    

Drive the move toward globally standardized and streamlined HR capabilities and processes, covering implementation, migration and retirement of legacy solutions.

    

Own the program’s Change Management and Communications strategy, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, communication and adoption.

    

Lead and support Change and Communications resources in executing the strategy, providing guidance and challenging approaches and outputs where necessary.

    

Ensure robust planning and coordination across data, integrations, testing, cutover, business continuity and transition into BAU operations.

    

Establish and maintain effective program governance, providing transparent reporting, insights and decision support to senior sponsors and steering stakeholders.

    

Foster strong collaboration across HR, IT, Enterprise Architecture, global functions, external vendors and other key stakeholders throughout the transformation.

Required Experience

    

Substantial experience in leading large-scale business and technology transformation programs.

    

Experience from at least two similar transformation programs involving enterprise system implementation, migration and/or decommissioning at scale.

    

Strong experience in both project and program management, including leading multiple workstreams.

    

Experience with process standardization, globalization or capability transformation within a complex organization.

    

Experience in developing and assessing business cases and translating business needs into clear scope, priorities and decisions.

    

Strong experience in developing and leading change management and communication strategies as part of large-scale transformation programs.

    

Experience with HR systems, particularly HRIS, together with a good understanding of HR processes, payroll, data and integrations.

    

Experience in change management, including stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, adoption and transition.

    

Sufficient technical knowledge to engage with architects and specialists and constructively challenge them when required.

    

Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct line-management authority, using an empathetic leadership approach that balances structure, accountability and culture.

    

Ability to quickly understand complex environments, get up to speed and establish clarity and momentum.

    

Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Preferred Experience

Experience with global HR transformation, SAP SuccessFactors or comparable HR platforms, payroll and time management, complex integrations, legacy-system decommissioning and large international organizations is considered an advantage. It is a plus if you are fluent in Swedish.

title: Treasury Analyst to Treasury Operations
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Saab Group Treasury is a central function with global responsibility for coordinating the financial activities within the group. As a Treasury Analyst in Treasury Operations, you will get a broad introduction to treasury by rotating across our core areas - back office and cash, cash management and risk/middle office - before specializing in the area(s) where you add the most value. You will work closely with the organization to develop, standardize, digitize and streamline our processes, and you will be a key resource for stepping in wherever the team needs support.

In this role you will:

    

Rotate through Treasury Operation's core functions to build broad, hands-on knowledge:

    

Back Office and Cash - execution of Saab's payments, booking of inflows, and administration/reconciliation of Treasury's transactions

    

Cash Management - bank accounts, cash pool structures, intercompany loans and capital injections

    

Risk/Middle Office - supporting the pension fund with NAV statements and risk management, monitoring financial risk measures (allocation mandates, modified duration, FX-hedge ratio, credit risk) and FX-flows

    

Provide flexible support across the team based on where the needs are greatest at any given time

    

Participate actively in improvement and digitalization projects across Treasury



Your profile

For this role, we are looking for someone who is analytical, structured and detail-oriented, with an interest in working with data, financial systems and problem solving. You are curious, hungry to learn and want broad exposure early in your career - this role is ideal for someone who wants to build a strong generalist foundation in treasury operations before deciding where to specialize.

As a person, you are proactive, adaptable and collaborative, comfortable moving between tasks and teams, and able to work both independently and as part of a group.

We believe you have:

    

A university degree in finance, engineering, economics or a related field and are either newly graduated or have up to around one year of work experience.

    

Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written as well as spoken.

Preferred qualifications:

    

Exposure to programming or database work through studies, projects or previous experience. Familiarity with SQL, Excel/VBA or similar tools is considered an advantage.

    

Experience working with Agresso or Quantum is considered an advantage.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst (Credit Risk)
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6128

Would you like to take a central role in shaping Nordea’s credit risk modelling landscape and add real business value for Nordea? Then this opportunity is for you.

We are looking for a (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our IRB modelling functions and drive the design, enhancement, and implementation of credit risk models across the organisation. The role combines advanced modelling, practical implementation of the models in our IT infrastructure and a sound understanding of banking. You need to enjoy working with large datasets, solve problems and find new and innovative solutions.

About our team

Meet the Risk Models Methodology & IRB models team. Our role is to develop and maintain models under IRB, and support other functions in the value chain . We strive to develop models that help business in their decisions and comply with relevant regulatory environment across multiple countries.

Our team adds value by accurately estimating the IRB risk parameters for Nordea’s customers. As the (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst you will play a valuable role in developing, maintaining and using models which accurately estimate Nordea customers’ credit risk and anchor these firmly in the business lines.

Given the nature of our data and regulatory requirements, we use advanced modelling techniques and big data technology. In addition to using leading techniques for modelling and data, the team’s role is general risk governance within credit risk modelling and methodology, including management of models, model implementation, data quality, documentation and model use.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Develop technical tools that can be used for model development and other analysis, using tools such as Python.
    Work on a subset of model lifecycle related activities like: data pipeline, data quality work, development, documentation, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, requirement setting, and user acceptance tests within credit and impairment models.
    Contribute to methodological standards, modelling tools, coding practices, and continuous improvement of the modelling framework.
    Drive projects within the IRB Models, and manage stakeholder relationships in the Risk, IT and Business organisations.
    Present and justify analyses, results, and their implications to stakeholders, either through periodic activities or through ad-hoc requests.
    Provide technical guidance, review the work of other modellers, and support setting modelling strategy and priorities.
    Stay informed on regulatory developments and industry practices.

You’ll join an international team with a variety of backgrounds and skills. We work closely with other teams across the bank which provides you with excellent opportunities for personal and professional development. Our working language is English.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you are:

    Curious, enjoy learning and are excited about brining your ideas to the table.
    Take ownership of the task but enjoy collaboration with others.
    Confident in advanced quantitative modelling and eager to challenge ideas constructively.
    Communicate complex statistical or methodological concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    Enjoy working with large datasets and navigate well in tools used to analyse them.
    Work well in a dynamic environment with varying workload.
    Are keen to find solutions and not only raise concerns.
    Able to think big picture but know that the devil is in the details. You are good at judging which details require extra attention.
    Committed to deliver high-quality work.
    Interested in coding and development of technical tools.

Your background and skills include:

    A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field, for instance economics, engineering, business, mathematics, science, statistics, finance, or similar.
    Interest or hands-on experience working with data & modelling and conducting complex data analysis in financial services.
    Previous experience with large volumes of data and programming. We use mainly Python / SQL.
    Interest in understanding of regulatory requirements related to IRB, IFRS9 and stress testing and different modelling techniques.

Seniority of the role and remuneration will depend on the level of the candidate’s experience in the relevant fields.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 13/09/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Matteus Arriaza-Hult, Head of Quantitative Methods & Projects at matteus.arriaza-hult@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

title: Measurement Specialist (Lund)
description:
🌟 Do you want to build systems that enable research and innovation? Do you enjoy diverse assignments in different technological fields? Are you interested in working at a smaller, specialized consulting company where your ideas are valued? If so, you would be a great fit for Prevas Test & Measurement! We want to offer you an inclusive and supportive work environment where your technical skills and knowledge will be put to good use.



We have been part of Prevas since October 2023, constituting our own unit specialized on test and measurement technology.

🔎 About the Role

As a consultant, you can work onsite with our customers or on projects at our office. We create solutions that help our customers get valuable insights from physical measurements.

As a measurement specialist, you will design and implement software and hardware solutions. In our projects, hardware can be electronics, sensors, measurement instruments, control units, mechanics, etc. A wide set of software tools and programming languages are essential to reaching the end goal. You will design and develop various systems, for example, automated test systems for electronics, mechanical test rigs for the automotive industry, or inspection systems for nuclear fuel rods.

    



🫵 About You You have a good understanding of physics, possibly through a research background, while being experienced in writing code for hardware control and instrumentation.   You enjoy taking initiative when needed and work well both independently and in a team. This means you are driven and able to take responsibility for your contributions. Additionally, you value the balance between listening to others and contributing your ideas, making you a highly appreciated coworker. You are driven by curiosity and motivated to find technical solutions to humankind’s big challenges.

    

You have an MSc in electrical engineering, engineering physics, or equivalent.

    

You have at least three years of work experience or a PhD in a relevant field.

    

You have experience in interfacing hardware with code that you have written.

    

You are well-versed in Python, C++, and/or LabVIEW.

    

You are proficient at speaking/reading/writing in English (Swedish is a plus).

    



✅ To succeed in this role you have experience with one or more of the following...

    

Measurement system development

    

Measurement technology

    

Automated hardware testing

    

The interface hardware/software

    

Sensor integration

    

Signal Processing

    

Big data analysis

🎉 Our Offer

At Prevas Test & Measurement you will have the opportunity to engage in both professional and personal growth. We offer flexible work hours, supportive leadership, and regular social activities that strengthen our company community. Our projects are challenging and diverse, we take on anything that can be physically measured, and engage with all industries that handle hardware.

    

🌱 Our Commitment to Sustainability Sustainability is at the core of our mission. We prioritize working with and supporting businesses that develop green technology to tackle environmental challenges. As a part of our team, you will contribute to creating sustainable solutions that exceed our customers’ expectations.

We place a lot of focus on creating a fun and sustainable working environment for all our coworkers. On our mission for an equal and inclusive environment, we aim to reach at least a 40% female workforce.

📩 Apply Now! Have we sparked your interest? Send us your application as soon as possible!

Applications close: 2026-12-31.

More About Prevas Test & Measurement Prevas Test & Measurement (formerly DVel) specializes in hardware test automation at our office in central Lund. We offer consulting services and/or deliver complete measurement systems and test rigs. Our projects are highly diverse, and our customers exist within several different industries. At present, we have 30 employees and look forward to growing with your addition.

As of October 2023, we became a part of Prevas. We are a business unit within Prevas South and will continue to provide expertise in test and measurement.

title: Operations Specialist
description:
About PDSVISION

PDSVISION is a global provider of IT solutions and services, supporting companies in areas such as product development, manufacturing, and aftermarket services.

We work with technologies including PLM, CAD, IoT, simulation, and digital service solutions. Our focus is simple: helping customers improve how they develop, produce, and maintain their products.

About the Role

As our Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in improving sales productivity, delivery control, data quality, renewal governance, and margin visibility by centralizing operational administration. You'll support our Sales, Service, Finance, and HR teams by owning operational processes, maintaining data quality across our business systems, and ensuring administrative activities run consistently and efficiently — freeing up our Account Managers, Project Managers, Service Managers, Customer Success, and leadership teams to focus on customers, delivery, and growth.

You will report to VP Operations and work closely with Sales and Customer Success leadership, Account Managers, Project Managers, Service leadership, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

    

Sales operations: CRM data quality, pipeline governance, renewal management, licensing administration, sales reporting, and order/invoice administration

    

Service operations: ERP administration, project governance, service backlog management, and delivery readiness

title: Senior Composite Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team?

Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels. Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation—the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not just operating in Stockholm, but now attracting orders from around the world.

Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, which results in cutting energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels.

And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel–free lakes and oceans.

Now you can be part of the amazing team at Candela! We are looking for a Senior Composite Manufacturing Engineer to join Candela’s Manufacturing Engineering team. In this role, you will take ownership of the serial production implementation of our advanced composite structures, including major hull components, deck structures, internal bulkheads, and exterior body parts. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role. You won’t just optimize processes on a screen; you will actively bridge the gap between R&D laminate designs and stable, scalable shop-floor execution. You’ll ensure our composite production is robust, repeatable, and seamlessly integrated into our main assembly lines.

What you'll do

    Drive Industrialization: Lead the transition of composite structures from R&D prototypes to high-quality, stable serial production, optimizing for cycle time, cost, and repeatability.
    Optimize Processes: Develop, evaluate, and enhance composite manufacturing methods (including vacuum resin infusion, compression moulding and wet layup) specifically for large-scale carbon fiber body parts.
    Tooling & Equipment: Design and develop specialized production tooling, molds, assembly fixtures, and workshop templates to improve lamination and trimming accuracy.
    CAD & Documentation: Create detailed assembly drawings, ply-book documentation, work instructions, and installation standards in CAD.
    DFM Collaboration: Work closely with Research & Development to provide critical Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) feedback, ensuring laminate schedules and joint designs are optimized for production stability.
    Quality & Validation: Establish process controls for layup, curing, trimming, bonding, and assembly. Lead troubleshooting efforts for production defects (e.g. structural and surface defects or bonding issues).
    Compliance & Safety: Ensure all composite manufacturing processes, chemical handling, and equipment comply with applicable environmental, health, and occupational safety regulations.
    Hands-on Prototyping: Participate actively in shop-floor testing, trial layups, first-article inspections, and the validation of new composite materials like fabrics, core materials, resins or adhesive systems.

What are we looking for?

    Education: M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, Marine Engineering or an equivalent technical field with a focus on composites.
    Experience: 5–10+ years of experience in composite manufacturing engineering, preferably within marine, automotive, or aerospace industries handling large-scale carbon fiber structures.
    Technical Depth: Deep understanding of composite manufacturing and repair techniques like: vacuum infusion, compression moulding, wet lamination and bonding. Experience in surface finishing processes like fairing and painting is beneficial (especially marine painting systems)
    CAD Proficiency: Competency in CAD design and mechanical/composite documentation (Catia v5 / 3DEXPERIENCE preferred).
    ERP and/or PLM documentation management
    Mindset: A practical, hands-on engineering approach. You are equally comfortable reviewing a 3D model and working alongside operators on the shop floor.
    Soft Skills: Strong cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical requirements clearly across disciplines.
    Language: Fluent in English; Swedish is a definite plus.

Form of employment: Full-time with initial 6 month probation period

Start date: ASAP

Location/base: Rotebro

Team: Manufacturing Engineering

Reporting to: Director Manufacturing Engineering

Why people love working at Candela?

At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels - we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges, and seeing the results in action - sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers! We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness. That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun - whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes, or cheering each other on during Candela Months, our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events.

We’re office-first but not office-only. We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person - but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated, and the ride is just as important as the destination.

Recruitment process:

We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well. Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR so please use our career website for you application.

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

title: Senior Compensation & Benefits Specialist - Netlight
description:

The opportunity to shape high-impact global C&B-topics in a fast-growing international organization

    

Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training

    

Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm

    

A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events

If you have any questions about our process or this role, please contact Martina Kolga, Recruitment Consultant (073-3222502, martina.kolga@zoey.se). title: Souschef
description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av den natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt större arrangemang. Inspirationen hämtas från stadens tre kulturer den svenska, samiska och tornedalsfinska och genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, där vi arbetar med modern teknik och hållbara arbetssätt för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön.

Nu söker vi en engagerad och driven souschef som vill bli en viktig del av vårt kök och samtidigt njuta av en storslagen fjällvärld med norrsken, midnattssol och fantastiska fritidsmöjligheter.

Som souschef har du en central roll i den dagliga driften av köket och ansvarar för att servicen flyter på med hög kvalitet, struktur och ett gott samarbete mellan kök och servering. Du leder genom att vara en förebild, stöttar och motiverar dina kollegor och bidrar till en positiv, respektfull och lösningsorienterad arbetsmiljö.

I rollen ingår även att säkerställa kvalitet, struktur och hygien i köket samt planera mise en place, lager och beställningar. Tillsammans med kökschefen arbetar du med kostnader, matsvinn och menyutveckling. Du är en viktig länk mellan kök, kökschef och servering, löser problem som uppstår under service och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamet och verksamheten.

Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för matlagning och yrket, trivs i ett högt tempo och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du har minst sex års erfarenhet inom restaurang, gärna med tre års utbildning och tre års arbetslivserfarenhet från à la carte-restaurang. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och/eller engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar. Som person är du engagerad, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att skapa riktigt bra mat och få ett team att fungera tillsammans.

Tjänsten är på 100 % och är en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetstiderna varierar utifrån verksamhetens behov och innebär arbete på både vardagar och helger. Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov.

Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. Välkommen med din ansökan!



At Camp Ripan, you have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.

At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our culinary inspiration comes from Kiruna’s three cultures Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian which are reflected throughout our entire operation. Camp Ripan’s kitchen is one of Sweden’s most climate-conscious kitchens, where we use modern technology and sustainable practices to minimise our environmental impact.

We are now looking for an engaged and driven Sous Chef who wants to become an important part of our kitchen team while enjoying the spectacular mountain environment, with the Northern Lights, Midnight Sun and fantastic outdoor activities right on your doorstep.

As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the kitchen and be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly, with high quality, structure and strong cooperation between the kitchen and other departments. You lead by example, support and motivate your colleagues, and contribute to a positive, respectful and solution-oriented working environment.

Your responsibilities will also include ensuring quality, structure and food safety in the kitchen, as well as planning mise en place, monitoring stock levels and handling orders. Together with the Head Chef, you will work with food and labour costs, food waste and menu development. You will be an important link between the kitchen, Head Chef and service, solving problems that arise during service and actively contributing to the development of both the team and the operation.

We are looking for someone with a genuine passion for cooking and the profession, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working as part of a team. You have at least six years of experience in the restaurant industry, preferably including three years of culinary education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant. You are confident in your professional role, have good communication skills in Swedish and/or English, and enjoy taking responsibility. As a person, you are committed, humble and solution-oriented, with a genuine motivation to create great food and help a team perform at its best.

This is a full-time, permanent position (100%). Working hours vary according to the needs of the business and include both weekdays and weekends. Staff accommodation is available if needed.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: OpenStack Neutron Specialist
description:
Cleura is one of the leading European provider of IT infrastructure services based on Open Source. Our company provides public, compliant, private and hybrid cloud solutions based on OpenStack. We are a fast growing company & European leaders in infrastructure as a service.We love having fun and working hard. We live to get that smile on our customers face when we solve a problem or simply provide something better than expected. That’s in fact why we go to work the next day.

Cleura is part of Iver , meaning that we have more than 1300 colleagues to support us in reaching our goals of becoming the primary European IaaS alternative.

About the Role

We're hiring an Infrastructure Engineer (OpenStack Neutron Specialist) to be part of the team who own and evolve the OpenStack networking layer that underpins Cleura's cloud services. This role sits within the Infrastructure Engineering team, which is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the infrastructure stack. You'll work closely with compute, storage, platform engineering, support, architecture, serving as a deep subject matter expert across Neutron and associated networking technologies including OVN, Open vSwitch, routing, metadata services, tenant isolation, and network automation.

This is a high-impact role at the heart of the Cleura cloud platform. You'll help ensure the availability, scalability, performance, and security of the networking layer, act as a 3rd/4th line escalation point for complex issues, and represent real-world operational needs in the upstream OpenStack community to help shape the future of Neutron and related projects.

Examples of responsibilities:

    Design scalable, resilient, and secure OpenStack networking platforms with a strong focus on Neutron and OVN/OVS.

    Own the architecture and day-to-day operation of virtual networking services, including L2/L3 networking, DHCP, metadata, floating IPs, NAT, security groups, and tenant segmentation.

    Ensure that OpenStack networking platforms meet security, compliance, and operational standards.

    Support upgrades, lifecycle management, and change execution across OpenStack networking services, with a strong focus on service continuity.

    Troubleshoot complex control plane and data plane issues across OpenStack networking components and the underlying Linux networking stack.

    Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for critical infrastructure services.

    Drive continuous improvements in network automation, provisioning, validation, monitoring, and recovery using infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.

About the team

    We love Open source! We primarily use Open-source technologies and enjoy contributing back when we can.

    We work in an agile way, when it's relevant.

    We are disciplined when it comes to testing changes.

    We have fun at work.

    We spend time to train new people who join the team and adjust how we work together via retrospectives.10% of our working hours are dedicated to Education. You get to sit in the school bench or even hold the teacher stick yourself.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with several years of experience in similar roles, with solid experience working in large-scale OpenStack environments and strong specialist expertise in Neutron, including ML2, OVN, Open vSwitch, routing, DHCP, metadata, provider networks, tenant networks, VLAN/VXLAN/Geneve, and security groups. You are self-driven, confident in your expertise, and have a strong desire to contribute to the success of both the team and our customers.

We also believe that you have the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with infrastructure, support, and architecture teams to solve complex technical problems. Experience contributing to, or working closely with, open-source communities is highly desirable—particularly within OpenStack, Neutron, OVN, Open vSwitch, or related networking projects.

In addition, you have:

    Strong experience in Linux systems administration and troubleshooting.

    A solid understanding of Linux networking concepts such as routing, bridging, namespaces, iptables/nftables, bonding, MTU, and packet flow analysis.

    Extensive experience investigating complex network behavior using tools such as tcpdump, ovs/ovn tooling, logs, and metrics.

    Experience designing and building automation for cloud infrastructure using tools such as Ansible.

    Very strong skills in Python and Bash.

    Experience working with highly available production platforms and change management in mission-critical environments.

    It's a bonus if you have previous experience working for a cloud provider.

What we offer

    Full-time position with 6-months probationary period.

    Leave Policy : 6 weeks vacation.

    Remote work: Work anywhere you want from the EU, and whenever you want, as long as you're working 40 hours a week in 5 working days.

I'm interested. What's next?

We'd like to hear from you! We have a few questions we would like to ask you. You'll be able to apply for this position until 1st of June 2026. We will start reviewing and inviting applications right away, so make sure you get yours in early.

Type of Employment

Full time position.

If you live in Sweden or Germany, you would be directly employed by Cleura or our German subsidiary.

If you live in any country other than Sweden or Germany (but within EU), we will enter into a contractor agreement as applicable to the legal situation in your country.

Salary and compensation will be negotiated during the interview process.

Location

Remote within EU or you are welcome to work in any of our offices in Sweden.

Start Date

Immediate/at your earliest convenience

title: Design Engineering Analyst
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:  Let's introduce ourselves  

The Solidity and Component NVH team is part of the Vehicle NVH and Sound Quality section within Vehicle Attributes, inside the Engineering organisation, at Volvo Cars Headquarters in Gothenburg. We play a key role in shaping the driving experience of Volvo Cars and in supporting the company’s strategic direction: “Freedom to move in a Personal, Sustainable & Safe way.”As a competence center, we bring together expertise in wind noise, propulsion NVH, operational sound quality, audio and ANC performance, interactive sound design, and solidity. Working in close collaboration with design and release ARTs, we contribute to shaping the key driving experience attributes that define how our vehicles are perceived by customers.

     What you'll do  

The Solidity and Component NVH team is responsible for the key driving experience attributes of squeak and rattle, solid feel, and operational sound quality. We partner closely with design teams across the organisation, providing the expertise and guidance needed to develop vehicles with strong attribute performance from concept phase through to mass production. In the early stages, we use CAE tools and engineering judgement to assess virtual designs in iterative development loops. In later phases, we validate performance in prototype vehicles and in production. The close collaboration between CAE engineers and test engineers is central to delivering clear feedback, robust analysis, and well-founded recommendations for improvement.As a Senior Test Engineer within Solidity and Component NVH, you will evaluate vehicles and components with a focus on squeak and rattle, solid feel, door closing sound, and noises from components such as window regulators and seat adjustment systems. Testing is carried out both on complete vehicles at test tracks and on component rigs. The role also includes travel to Volvo Cars production sites around the world when evaluations are needed in factory environments, during development, industrialisation, or launch support.Your work will include root cause analysis and close collaboration with responsible designers, CAE engineers, release teams, and suppliers to identify improvements and drive robust solutions. You will also contribute to capturing learnings in design guidelines, requirements, and test methods together with the CAE team and the design and release organisations. Acoustic measurement equipment and commercial NVH software are an integrated part of our daily work, used continuously for analysis, troubleshooting, evaluation, and validation throughout the development process. These tools help us understand issues, confirm performance, and provide clear feedback and recommendations to design teams.

   Profile description: What you'll bring  

To succeed in this role, we believe you bring the following skills and experience:Required qualifications:




    Relevant engineering degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Technical Acoustics, Structural Dynamics, or similar, combined with substantial relevant experience.
    Strong knowledge of structural dynamics, acoustics, and signal processing.
    Extensive hands-on experience in squeak and rattle and/or NVH testing, with a practical and problem-solving approach.
    Experience using commercial measurement systems and NVH test tools for evaluation and troubleshooting.
    A clear understanding of the value of combining physical test and CAE methods.
    Driving licence.



Meritorious qualifications:




    Experience working with the assembly or disassembly of complex systems, such as vehicles, is considered an advantage.  
    Experience from vehicle development, launch activities, or production support is considered an advantage.
    Experience from proving ground, rig, shaker, or other component and vehicle test environments is considered an advantage.
    Experience in supplier collaboration, issue resolution, or cross-functional engineering work is considered an advantage.
    Experience in requirement setting, method development, or creation of design guidelines is considered an advantage.



Personal qualities:




    Analytical capability
    Good interpersonal skills
    Good communications skills
    Ability to build networks
    Customer focused
    Result oriented
    Ability to work independently and in a team
    Interest in cars and technology
    Fluent in English, written and spoken

Who we are

Sharkmob is a Swedish game developer founded in 2017. We create AAA-quality games for PC and console, using the Unreal Engine to power our ambitions of taking multiplayer games to new heights. We are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative workplace where creativity can thrive. Our culture is built around shared ownership, a passion for creating great games, and, just as importantly, having fun along the way.

We’d love for you to join us on our journey and become part of our crew. To learn more about Sharkmob, our projects, and the perks of being a crew member, visit our homepage.

title: Category Manager Raw Material
description:
Husqvarna Group is a global leading producer of outdoor power products for forest, park and garden care. Products include chainsaws, trimmers, robotic lawn mowers and ride-on lawn mowers. The Group is also the European leader in garden watering products and a global leader in cutting equipment and diamond tools for the construction and stone industries.

The Group's products and solutions are sold under brands including Husqvarna, Gardena, McCulloch, Poulan Pro, Weed Eater, Flymo, Zenoah and Diamant Boart via dealers and retailers to consumers and professionals in more than 100 countries. Net sales in 2024 amounted to SEK 48,3 billion SEK, and the Group has more than 13 300 employees in 40 countries.

Organization

Sourcing at Husqvarna Division is organized in several categories which all are responsible for securing quality, delivery, cost efficiency and sustainability of supply within the category. One of the key functions within Sourcing is Category Management of direct material category and related commercial relationships with suppliers.

The Sourcing Regional Categories Europe is responsible for procuring all direct material used in products with a global set up of both plants and suppliers. Our task is to ensure that the greatest value is provided to the organization´s internal customers and thereby positively affecting the overall business result.

Your future challenge

As Category Manager Raw Material you are part of a highly motivated team of Category Managers and Operational Buyers and you report to the Sourcing Director Categories Europe. Your primary responsibility is to develop and apply business strategy and relationship management, deliver value in terms of quality, delivery, cost efficiency and sustainability for your category during the full product life cycle.

The role requires travelling to suppliers as well as some of Husqvarna’s Key sites. You will face a broad role with heavy responsibilities, but also a good base for future growth within the company.

Your responsibilities

•  Be ultimately responsible for all commercial relations with the suppliers within your Category and secure set targets of cost, quality, delivery and sustainability.

•  Create long term strategies, well anchored with internal stakeholders, for your Category to deliver optimized value and drive implementation of the same.

•  Develop and maintain vendor agreements.

•  Manage sourcing projects and lead negotiations of commercial terms and conditions.

•  Build and maintain mutually beneficial relations with ALL suppliers in order to improve supplier performance and collaboration, not only to decrease costs and eliminate waste but also to utilize the suppliers full potential in areas such as product development and innovation.

•  Build and maintain strong internal relations within sourcing functions such as Project Sourcing, Supplier Quality Assurance and Supplier Development but also with other internal stakeholders such as R&D, Logistics and Manufacturing.

•  Set up and manage the annual budget of cost saving activities and negotiations.

Your qualifications

You have a passion for, as well as extensive experience within sourcing of direct material and mechanic components. You are a self-motivated team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills who thrive in a dynamic and challenging environment. You have the ability to independently manage complex sourcing projects and initiatives with internal and external stakeholders. You are a true problem solver who enjoys reducing ambiguity and you are constantly moving forward.

To be a suitable candidate for the role, we believe you have the following.

Education

Master’s Degree in engineering or business administration together with recognized qualification in Sourcing or other relevant academic background.

Experience

Minimum 5 years of purchasing experience, preferably in category management positions. Extensive technical experience of mechanic or mechatronic components. Excellent knowledge of strategic sourcing methodologies, fact-based negotiation and cross-functional team collaboration. Extensive experience of working in an international environment. Leadership and change management experience is a merit.

Personal skills

Excellent commercial understanding. Strong planning-, organizational-, analytical- and problem solving skills. Ability to manage various internal stakeholders and their expectations. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to outline RFP’s as well as contracts and agreements. Strong knowledge of basic software such as Microsoft Office and database handling.

Languages

Swedish and Fluency in English is required and other is a merit.

This position is based in Huskvarna.

Your application

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application! Selection is ongoing. Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

For questions regarding the process please contact

Recruiter: Jonathan Olsson jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com or

Hiring Manager: Björn Rembsgård bjorn.rembsgard@husqvarnagroup.com

title: Development Engineer - Future Driver Displays
description:
Development Engineer - Future Driver Displays

TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let's make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden

Are you curious about software development and passionate about creating intuitive digital experiences for drivers? We are looking for a Development Engineer to join our team working with future driver displays.



In this role, you will contribute to the development of high-quality display functions used in trucks and buses. You will work in a cross-functional agile team, collaborating with developers, designers, testers, product owners and other stakeholders to bring modern, reliable and user-friendly driver displays to life.



This role can suit both junior and more experienced developers. What matters most to us is your mindset: that you are eager to learn, take responsibility, collaborate well with others and want to grow together with the team.

Job Responsibilities

As a Development Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and maintaining software for embedded driver display systems. The work includes both frontend and backend development, with a focus on creating efficient, reliable and user-friendly solutions.



You will contribute to transforming design ideas and user needs into working software, while considering performance, quality and the limitations of embedded environments. You will also take part in software design discussions, implementation, troubleshooting, debugging and testing in rigs as well as in vehicles.



Together with your team, you will help ensure that our driver displays provide a seamless and premium experience for our customers.



It is beneficial, but not required, if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

    Qt/QML, C or C++
    Embedded Linux or other resource-constrained environments
    UI development
    HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript or modern frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular
    Git or other version control systems
    Security and data protection in embedded systems
    Automotive industry or embedded software development

Who You Are

We are looking for a person who enjoys working in a team and wants to contribute to both the product and the way we work. You are curious, open-minded and motivated by learning new technologies, tools and methods.

We believe that you:

    Have a strong team mindset and put the team's deliveries ahead of individual prestige
    Are solution-oriented and naturally look for ways to move forward when facing challenges
    Are curious, eager to learn and willing to try, implement and improve methods, tools and techniques
    Communicate clearly and contribute to a positive and collaborative team culture
    Are structured, responsible and care about quality in your work
    Have a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field
    Have studied or worked with C++ programming, or have a strong willingness and ability to learn it
    

We value your mindset and way of working just as much as your technical experience. Whether you are early in your career or bring several years of experience, we are interested in people who want to learn, take ownership and grow with us.

As we work in an international environment, good written and spoken English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

This Is Us

At Cluster Functions, we develop the GUI and business logic for driver displays, ensuring drivers receive the right information at the right time. Our agile teams, made up of diverse and collaborative developers, work across the Traton Group to innovate and expand our vehicle solutions. We value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and a commitment to delivering the best driver experience.



Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-07. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in plant cell biology
description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

The long-term goal of our research is to understand the signaling mechanisms regulating plant growth and development (https://www.upsc.se/stephane_vergerhttps://www.upsc.se/stephane_vergerie_robert). You will be part of a team that work at building a better understanding in the signaling controlling cell fate acquisition in Arabidopsis root. The candidate postdoc fellow will aim at dissecting the modes of action of positional information signaling in this process.

The project is a collaborative project including 4 different research groups and is based on cell biology including live confocal microscopy, molecular biology, microfluidics, electrophysiology and cell wall biology.

Your profile

Applicants require a doctoral degree in molecular, cell or developmental biology, or related disciplines. Furthermore, applicants should be proficient in English both verbally and in writing, and should have the ability to work independently as well as in collaboration with others. Experience in confocal microscopy, Arabidopsis, root development is of merit.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension.

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 08 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Stockholm, Sweden

title: Group FP&A Manager

Instabee has come a long way in a short time. We've built one of Europe's leading delivery companies through strong growth, acquisitions and continuous innovation. But we're still early in our journey, and the next chapter will require even better planning, sharper execution and smarter decision-making.

That's where you come in.

What you'll do

Partner with the CFO on analyses, Board material, presentations and other high-impact projects.

Develop our FP&A capabilities, processes and tools - leveraging AI to fundamentally rethink how FP&A operates and creates value.

    

Build the models, analyses and management reporting that turn financial information into better decisions.

This isn't a role where everything is already in place. Some days you'll work on long-term strategy. Other days you'll improve forecasting, prepare management material or solve a business problem. We think the best finance leaders enjoy both.

Who you are

You likely have experience from a top-tier strategy consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar), or another highly analytical environment, with a track record of independently owning complex problems and influencing senior stakeholders.
